Name: SecondValues
SQL:
-- sgl.query(SecondValues, many)
SELECT
    id,
    NTH_VALUE(id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS second_id,
    NTH_VALUE(score, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS second_score
FROM items;
Template:
SELECT
    ⟨c0:id⟩,
    ⟨c1 aliased:NTH_VALUE(id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)⟩ AS second_id,
    ⟨c2 aliased:NTH_VALUE(score, 2) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)⟩ AS second_score
FROM items;
